validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: confirmed real. P6724 is the '4' line of the EWPS-4->EWPS-6 corridor of Aramco's Master Gas System Phase 3 (MGS-3 / East-West Gas Pipeline expansion). Blackridge Research independently itemizes the MGS-3 EPC packages and lists Package 6 verbatim: 'Lay 56-inch diameter pipelines (EWGP-3 and EWGP-4) from EWPS-4 to EWPS-6 (370 km)', contractor Sinopec. DMS Projects and Pipeline Technology Journal independently corroborate the MGS-3 program (56-inch east-west trunk lines between EWPS pump stations, ~4,000-4,153 km total, 3.15 bscfd added capacity, construction from Q2 2024, completion Q4 2028). The existing MEED ref also lists 56-inch EWPS-to-EWPS corridor packages. So this is not a GEM-only/hallucinated entity. CLASSIFICATION: correct. It is a dry-gas transmission TRUNK line (sales-gas East-West corridor of the Master Gas System), 56-inch -- not NGL, not a gathering/feeder line. Fuel=Gas and PipelineType=transmission both confirmed. DUPLICATE CHECK (vs P6723, identical 185 km / 56in / construction twin): NOT a duplicate error. The source names TWO distinct parallel lines on this corridor -- EWGP-3 (= GEM '3' line = P6723) and EWGP-4 (= GEM '4' line = P6724) -- consistent with GEM's standing convention of giving each parallel line its own ProjectID (cf. the UBTG/Berri and Berri-Abu Ali parallel pairs elsewhere in the Saudi roster). P6723 and P6724 are the intended pair, not a double-count. SPEC CAVEAT (the one real flag): every independent source that quantifies this corridor gives 370 km for the package covering BOTH the '3' and '4' lines together (Blackridge: '370 km'; the WebSearch summary explicitly: 'the 56-inch east-west gas pipelines three and four from EWPS-4 to EWPS-6 cover 370km'). The MEED article cited by GEM for Length lists corridor packages but does not state '185 km' (the worklist auto-check already failed to find '185' on the MEED page). GEM's 185 km is therefore a derived figure = 370 km / 2 parallel lines. It is a defensible allocation and 56-inch diameter and construction status are independently solid, but the per-line 185 km is not directly sourced. ATTRIBUTION: Owner/Operator = Saudi Aramco, confirmed by all sources; Eastern Province corridor (EWPS-4 -> EWPS-6 pump stations). Start year 2028 = completion (Q4 2028), well sourced.

fills.researcher_notes: Location [ref] was blank (MISSING_REF). Blackridge Package 6 explicitly states pipelines run 'from EWPS-4 to EWPS-6', placing the corridor in Saudi Arabia's Eastern Province (the East-West sales-gas trunk corridor). Province given as Eastern Province at the EWPS-4 origin end; the East-West line ultimately runs toward Yanbu in the west, but the EWPS-4->EWPS-6 sub-segment is wholly in the eastern half. Endpoint names are pump-station IDs (EWPS-4/EWPS-6), not towns -- recorded as such rather than fabricating settlement names.

summary: P6724 (EWPS-4->EWPS-6 '4' = EWGP-4, MGS-3) is real, correctly classed as a 56in dry-gas transmission trunk line, and NOT a duplicate of P6723 (its true parallel twin EWGP-3); sole caveat is that the 185 km length is a GEM-derived half of the 370 km combined two-line package, not directly sourced.
